page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Above the text a woodcut ornament band. Headings in the upper part of the column, then running text below. No marginal notes. Show-through from the reverse page is visible faintly and is not transcribed.

main_text.head: Amplissimo, Nobilissimo, Strenuissimo Viro, DOMINO DN. NICOLAO DACHSELHOFERO,
main_text.p: Nuper Ex-Toparchæ Königsfeldensi meritissimo, nuncque in Illustrissimorum D. D. Bernatum cohortibus, quæ Christianis. Galliarum Regi militant, Capitaneo, Domino in Uzingen &c. Mœcenati suo Spectatissimo.

Quô Consilio, quave Confidentia, Vir Strenuissime, illustris nominis tui facem huic Thesium mearum fasciculo præferre ausim, non putem esse, quod quisquam miretur; nec Tu ipse, spero, factum indignaberis, postquam ejus rationem paucis exposuero, non equidem, quod vulgo usu venit, id in animo habui laudum scilicet Tuarum florida ratione pertexendo, gratiam Tuam aucupari. Licet enim & occasio & uberrima suppetat decantandi materia, tum Genus & Proavos, & quæ non feceris ipse

page.notes: Woodcut ornament above the heading is not text. The word "Uzingen" is printed in a larger black-letter style within the line. Faint show-through of the reverse page (including a partly visible imprint line near the foot) is disregarded. Some letters in the body are blurred (e.g. "Thesium", "ipse" at the end of the last line set apart to the right); read as printed.
